|description2 = ''Howling Gale'' can be recast at any time within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
|leveling     = {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 195}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Damage Per Second|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|55+10*3 to 195+30*3}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
|description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Janna''' launches the whirlwind in the direction she targeted over {{fd|1.25}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{pp|type=seconds charged|0.5 to 1.25|0 to 1.5 by 0.1}} seconds.
|cooldown     = 14
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = {{ap|90 to 110}}
|costtype     = mana
|cast time    = none
|range        = {{pp|type=seconds charged|1100 to 1000*1.76|0 to 3 by 1|changedisplay=true|formula=Increases by 22 every 0.1 seconds.}}
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 240
|speed        = {{pp|type=seconds charged|(880 to 1408)|0 to 3 by 1|changedisplay=true|formula  = Always travels for 1.25 seconds.}}
|targeting    = [[Direction-targeted|Direction]] / [[Auto-targeted|Auto]]
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = magic
|projectile   = true
|spelleffects = area of effect
|onhiteffects = 
|spellshield  = True
|notes        =

* The storm does not interact with enemy units that stand on top of it while it is charging.
